name: GT-Racing-Hyundai-Edition-vita
description: Android to PS Vita port of Gameloft's GT Racing Hyundai Edition
long_description: This port runs the compiled native ARM library (`libGTRacing.so`) from the Android release directly on the PS Vita's ARM Cortex-A9 processor, using a custom dynamic loader (*soloader*) and an Android environment emulation layer (*FalsoJNI*), with vitaGL providing hardware-accelerated GLES 1.1 rendering.
